name: Intra Urbes — Light Rail / Streetcar
description: Intra Urbes fantasy streetcars: SC1 Solano–Elysian / stadium gates; SC1A Stadium Way connector; SC2 Frogtown–Cypress Park–Figueroa–Colorado; SC3 Cypress–Eagle Rock–York; SC3A Eagle Rock–Colorado branch; SC4 Los Feliz–Riverside / Fletcher. Not official projects; alignments and stops are conceptual. SC5 serves César Chávez from Union Station to Atlantic; SC6 follows Pico from Santa Monica to Downtown. SC7 follows Main Street from Florence, turns via MLK to San Pedro Street, and continues to Little Tokyo, connecting with SC6 at Pico. SC8–SC37 add an interconnected local grid across Central, South and East LA, the Westside, San Fernando Valley, San Gabriel Valley, Pasadena and South Bay, feeding the Inter Urbes network including the new Reseda R Line. Inter Urbes V connects Union Station to Holt Avenue in Pomona via Mission Road and Valley Boulevard. SC38 serves Garfield from Huntington to Imperial; SC23 reaches Colorado, and SC22 reaches the authored Garvey/Rosemead C terminal. The Valley and Mission corridor is Inter Urbes heavy rail. SC39 follows Griffin from Mission to Broadway/Daly on H, with a walking transfer to V at Valley/Mission. SC19 extends north on Soto to H at Huntington, retaining its V transfer at Valley. SC40 serves Virgil between Sunset and Wilshire; SC41 serves Temple between Virgil and Alameda, sharing a Virgil/Temple stop. SC10A branches east from Third/Alvarado along Third Street to Alameda, connecting SC34 Broadway and SC7 San Pedro.

properties.description: Conceptual neighborhood streetcar from Union Station through Chinatown and Solano Canyon, along Academy Road and Stadium Way, stopping at Dodger Stadium / Sunset Gate A, then following Vin Scully Avenue to Sunset Boulevard. Gate A is served at its public-road approach; stops along the corridor provide walking access toward Gates B, C, and D. Gate E is outside this alignment.
